content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: from Ir Swap, the Static Data menu item (clicks 104 and 151, then overlay shown and navigation to counterparty:screen) sends the user to Counterparty, and they return through the Ir Swap tab (clicks 126 and 173) after about 3 s, which suggests the counterparty step needs a trip out of the trade screen; the Counterparty field also shows a visible error (64:a70, 63:a72) before that round trip.", "fix": "Fix: On the Ir Swap screen, change the Counterparty menu route under the Static Data menu (the menuitem at about x=600\u2013625, y=50 that navigates to counterparty:screen) so it opens a counterparty lookup panel in place, or add a lookup control beside the Counterparty textbox in the Ir Swap form, so users can select a counterparty without leaving Ir Swap.", "cited_event_ids": ["95", "104", "109:w121", "app:13", "126", "app:15", "142", "151", "app:18", "173", "app:20", "63:a72", "64:a70", "app:21", "app:23", "app:26", "app:28"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The purpose of each Counterparty visit is not visible in the events, so it is unknown whether users were looking up, checking, or editing counterparty data.", "The events do not show what the Counterparty screen displays or whether it resolves the Ir Swap error.", "The error elements at 64:a70 and 63:a72 are not shown to be cleared by the Counterparty visit.", "Only the three-window sample is available; the 6-session totals and median 6.0 s figure are taken from the insight facts without independent verification.", "The menu item label is inferred from its position and click path, not from a visible label."]}
